mechanism: Amikacin (aminoglycoside) may cause nephrotoxicity and ototoxicity, which could affect buprenorphine clearance and increase opioid levels; buprenorphine may mask ototoxicity symptoms through CNS depression.
action: Monitor renal function, hearing, and buprenorphine levels during concurrent use; ensure adequate hydration and use lowest effective amikacin dose for shortest duration.
